scope: Authored PiPER policies in native MuJoCo with synthetic rigid objects and privileged simulator observations. Browser replay uses recorded poses; no learned policy, hardware safety qualification or real-world transfer result.

host.compute: CPU native simulation; no GPU required for benchmark. Browser replay needs WebGL2.

metrics.contact_force_scope: sum of normal shoe-to-robot/tool forces, excluding table
metrics.recorded_state_scope: privileged native state; qpos has 6 arm radians, 2 jaw metres, shoe XYZ metres and quaternion wxyz; qvel has 6 arm rad/s, 2 jaw m/s, shoe linear m/s and angular rad/s; controls are 6 joint radians plus jaw metres; requested targets update every20ms and issued controls are rate limited every2ms
metrics.retention_criterion: shoe bottom >35 mm with both fingers contacting, tool and world force each <0.01 N for final 500 ms
metrics.comparison_scope: v0.1 mounted-rake controller, not original no-tool baseline

events.message: retrieved but jaw lift not retained

independent_score.scope: Synthetic continuous-retention scoring. No injury threshold, physical safety or learned policy claim.
independent_score.detection_scope: Independent native scoring-condition loss after 100 ms acquisition. Recovery request and first issued native control packet are separate; packet issuance does not establish changed target, physical stopping or successful recovery. Planned releases can also break this condition, so uncovered episodes are not certified missed alarms. Unmatched events may use another conservative predicate; they are not automatically false alarms. Times exclude sensor/transport latency and hardware stopping time.

metrics.regrasp_scope: one supported lowering, reopening and recentered retry using the same original grasp geometry; no alternate learned grasp
metrics.comparison_scope: unchanged v0.1 mounted-rake controller versus continuous-grip controller on identical model
metrics.observation_scope: privileged native state; first contact loss recorded at2ms, decisions at20ms; loss debounce requires three failed samples spanning40ms, not continuous native loss; motion-slip window200ms plus sampled debounce; command issue is not hardware response
metrics.test_lift_scope: 40 mm observed TCP checkpoint during a continuous trajectory; incipient object rise and partial unloading, not unsupported success
metrics.retention_criterion: final500ms continuous originz>35mm, bothfingernormalforces>0.01N, world/tool/otherrobot support each<0.01N
